messages.context: Loras：Selecting [Those Precursors are very human after all]
messages.text: Adding to this, the Starborns' power was intrinsically tied to the belief of their followers.

messages.context: Loras：Selecting [Those Precursors are very human after all]
messages.text: As the Precursors' faith diminished, so too did the might of the Starborns, weakening them in this crucial confrontation.

messages.text: As for the Precursors, they vanished without a trace, a puzzling paradox.

messages.context: Loras：Selecting [So how does the story end?]
messages.text: Here's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the Starborn of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.
messages.raw: §fHere's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the Starborn of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.

messages.zh: 我的推测是: 时间星裔预见了将至的末日,于是孤注一掷。或许正因为众生都信仰时间,他才拥有最强大的力量。

messages.context: Loras：Selecting [So how does the story end?]
messages.text: He propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.
messages.raw: §fHe propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.

messages.zh: 他把先驱推向了遥远的未来,希望到那时,有人能与他们抗衡。
